native_sources.name: Roles & Capabilities
native_sources.notes: Identity/authorization substrate only; no chat participant or moderation engine.

native_sources.name: WordPress REST API
native_sources.notes: Bounded request transport substrate; not realtime/private-chat semantics.

native_sources.name: Heartbeat API
native_sources.notes: Ephemeral polling substrate; does not define presence/typing truth or delivery guarantees.

native_sources.name: Comments
native_sources.notes: Public/content discussion primitive and explicitly not canonical private-chat persistence.

native_sources.name: Media
native_sources.notes: Attachment/resource substrate; private access requires separate authorization.

native_sources.name: WP-Cron
native_sources.notes: Scheduling substrate delegated to the Cron/Job owner.

records.label: Conversation Identity / Type / Lifecycle / Linked Resource
records.notes: WordPress core has no private/realtime conversation-definition engine; comments are explicitly not the canonical private-chat storage model.

records.label: Conversation Creation / Duplicate-Prevention Policy
records.notes: Native users/session/capabilities are inputs only; duplicate-prevention and invite semantics remain Chat-owned.

records.label: Participant Derivation / Invite / Leave / Maximum
records.notes: User/site membership may be referenced, but participant derivation/invite/leave state remains Chat-owned.

records.label: Active / Closed / Archived / Moderation Hold
records.notes: WordPress core has no private-chat conversation lifecycle state machine.

records.label: Safe Text / Markdown / Link / Emoji Policy
records.notes: Core sanitization helpers are substrate only; comments/content models are not reused as canonical private-message storage.

records.label: Mentions / Attachments / Length Policy
records.notes: Mentions must be authorization-filtered and attachments stay Media/File-owned references with private access re-checks.

records.label: Edit / Delete / Redaction Windows
records.notes: No native private-message edit/delete/redaction-window contract exists.

records.label: Reply-To / Reactions
records.notes: WordPress core has no private-chat reply/reaction engine.

records.label: Idempotency / Schema Version / Concurrency / Pagination
records.notes: REST pagination/idempotent request patterns are transport substrate only; message schema/concurrency remain Chat-owned.

records.label: Last-Read Cursor / Unread / Read Receipts
records.notes: No native unread cursor/read-receipt model exists.

records.label: Presence / Typing Privacy Policy
records.notes: Heartbeat may carry ephemeral polling data but does not define presence/typing privacy truth or realtime guarantees.

records.label: Polling / Realtime Transport Profile & Degraded State
records.notes: REST/AJAX/Heartbeat may serve bounded native-compatible polling adapters. WebSocket/SSE/realtime transports are provider-specific and must expose honest degraded-state behavior rather than being labelled realtime by default.

records.label: Notification / Mute / Digest References
records.notes: Surface 19 Notifications owns occurrence/routing/mute/digest semantics; Chat stores only canonical references.

records.label: Reporting / Moderation / Blocking / Rate Limits
records.notes: Native capability checks are authorization inputs, not a moderation queue/product engine.

records.label: Private Attachment Authorization
records.notes: Media/File owns resources; every private attachment access must re-check conversation/resource authorization and public Media URLs are insufficient protection.

records.label: Authorized Search / Retention / Erasure / Diagnostics / Definition Portability
records.notes: Native personal-data exporter/eraser hooks are privacy integration substrate; search/index/import-export remain delegated to their canonical owners where applicable.

records.label: Arbitrary HTML / Script in Message Bodies
records.notes: Arbitrary HTML/script in private message bodies remains rejected; safe renderer formats and bounded providers only.

coverage.notes: Native identity/auth, REST/AJAX/Heartbeat, comments, media, privacy and Cron provenance is integrated as adjacent/canonical-owner substrate only. WordPress core has no private/realtime Chat engine; market review must cover actual messaging/provider semantics and raw HTML stays rejected.
